sources.use: Ideas only: inspect governed metric definitions and distinguish query drafting from actual execution. No four-stage route, wording, diagrams or SQL copied.

Ideas only: inspect data before modeling, bounded warehouse inspection and untrusted metadata/results. No source text copied.

requiredCapabilities: Read supplied tables, metadata and reports
capabilityLimits: Instructions do not supply database access, tool syntax for every engine, statistical qualification or a causal identification design.
sideEffects: No automatic source writes, connector installation, credential acquisition, remote publication or operational action. Queries can still incur cost or expose data and remain subject to actual tool authority.
evaluation: Main agent owns all model runs, frozen independent gold and host verification. This draft carries no passing behavioral claim.
